title: Pasta all'Amatriciana
author: Lorenzo
description: Crisp guanciale, tomato and pecorino: the Roman classic, with a little heat.
steps: Render the guanciale in a dry pan over medium heat until golden. Lift it out and keep the fat in the pan.
Deglaze with the wine, then add the tomatoes, crushed by hand, and the chili. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Boil the bucatini in salted water until al dente.
Put the guanciale back in the sauce, toss in the pasta with a splash of its water, and finish with the pecorino.
